items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: We had to get Leopold Stokowski (PHONETIC) out of the line. He was standing around the corner in the snow. We found out he was in line. We went around and got him out of the line and gave him a box in the theater.

ctx.x: And you toured with Hampton for --

I was with Hampton from the end of -- from the fall of 1940 until October, '42, we did our things. We had a great success when we first went to New York. We had such enormous crowds and at the Apollo Theater in Harlem, at our first showing there, we had people standing a half a block in line in triple formation in both directions. We had to get Leopold Stokowski (PHONETIC) out of the line. He was standing around the corner in the snow. We found out he was in
line. We went around and got him out of the line and gave him a box in the theater. He was waiting there to see what this new band was bringing to town.
